rule: Numbers are immutable. Corrections are additive. Do not silently rename, replace, or skip numbers. Every number must be recorded in GitHub with path, commit, status, and build-match notes.
nextGate: Commander must say NEXT before Number 13 is created.
globalBuildMatchRule: A markdown doctrine file is repo proof of documentation only. It is not runtime proof. Validators, manifests, components, APIs, screenshots, builds, and deployments must be tracked separately.

forbiddenBehaviors: Do not silently change a number's meaning.
Do not replace an existing number instead of adding a correction.
Do not skip ahead without Commander NEXT.
Do not claim runtime proof from markdown files.
Do not claim validators passed unless they were run and output is available.
Do not ignore the Commander app stack registry in future numbers.
Do not treat Lovable as absent or as the whole Number 11.
Do not treat Airtable as final truth.
Do not treat GitHub docs as document validity or runtime proof.
